purpose: An internal assistant that answers employees' questions about company policy — leave, expenses, benefits, conduct — grounded in the current policy library and always citing the exact document and section it drew from.
target_audience: HR, who maintain the policies and field the repeats

policy_answers.description: An employee asks a policy question in plain language and gets an answer drawn from the company's own policy documents, with a citation to the source document and section so they can verify it. The policy library is large, updated often by HR, and answers must come only from it — never from general knowledge.
policy_answers.example: "How many days of bereavement leave do I get?" returns the answer plus a link to Leave Policy section 4.2.

source_links.description: Every answer links back to the underlying policy documents it was drawn from.

differentiators: Answers come only from current company policy and always cite their source.
